steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Evaluation means assessing what worked, what didn't, and why — it is the most important part of citizenship action and worth the most marks in the exam. | Key Fact: Evaluate by comparing outcomes against original aims: Did you achieve what you set out to do? How do you know? What evidence supports your assessment? | Key Fact: Consider both intended outcomes (what you planned) and unintended outcomes (unexpected results, positive or negative). | Key Fact: Use quantitative evidence (numbers: petition signatures, survey responses, attendance figures) and qualitative evidence (quotes, testimonials, observations, feedback).
